_about: Carrier identities, plan classifications, benefit schedules and outcome rules for the health-question search. Schedules and rules come from Randy's approved underwriting interpretations (October 2026). Question wording is NOT here and never in this public repository: the verbatim question records live only in the private search store (see server/health-search/README.md). Consumer-facing text in this file must be plain English with no em dashes.

cardiac-timeframe.explanation: For this question the timing matters. Within 12 months: declined. From 12 through 24 months: graded benefit. More than 24 months ago: level coverage is possible, subject to the other questions. The exact time limits are in the question wording above.

part-a.explanation: A YES answer to any Part A question means the applicant does not qualify for this plan. Part A answers come first: they decide eligibility before Parts B and C.

part-b.explanation: If every Part A answer is NO, a YES answer here points to the modified benefit plan.

part-c.explanation: Part C answers decide between the standard and preferred rate classes. Both give full coverage from the first day; they differ in price.
